subject.why: It clearly depicts a gold necklace featuring a prominent heart-shaped ruby pendant with small pearls set between the chain links.

category.why: The necklace rests on a plain flat green surface viewed from slightly above, set against a smooth gradient green wall of a contrasting tone.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, borders, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The necklace is centrally framed with clear margins around all sides without cropping or crowding the edges.

colour.why: The colours are bright, saturated, and juicy, with the gold and ruby pendant contrasting cleanly against the vibrant green backdrop.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky with no noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary background props.

style.why: The rendering features smooth chunky volumes, satin sheens, soft shadows, and clean edges matching the game's 3D casual art style.
